caption: The drawing shows two outlined vessels positioned side by side on a plain, light-colored background. Both vessels have a rounded base and a narrow neck; the vessel on the left has a handle attached from the neck to the shoulder, while the vessel on the right does not have a handle. Each vessel features a decorative band near the neck rendered in a blue hue, with the band on the left vessel incorporating a curved, vine-like element that loops near the handle and surrounds the neck, while the right vessel has a similar swirling blue pattern beneath its rim. The outlines of the vessels are in black, and the rest of the space in the drawing is unadorned, emphasizing the shapes and decorations of the vessels.
title: Jug
